messages:
Micah: Cutting release candidate from main: v2.7.0-rc3. Targeting promotion in today's change window (16:00 PT). Posting checklist + asks. @Anika @Kevin please review.
ci-bot: build v2.7.0-rc3 (build #345) succeeded. Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/v2.7.0-rc3.tar.gz
Anika: Quick Q — is the new routing feature-flag enabled in this candidate? we should keep it off for initial canary.
Micah: routing flag is OFF in this RC. Confirmed in manifest.
Kevin: Canary plan proposal: 5% traffic for 30m, then 25% for 1h if stable, then ramp to 100%. Abort if error-rate > 1% or p95 latency increases by >50ms.
Sara: Any datastore/schema migrations in this deploy?
Micah: No migrations. Only runtime params and autoscale tweaks.
Dinesh: I'll run smoke + e2e in staging now. ETA ~30m. Test matrix: auth, embeddings, streaming.
ci-bot: running smoke tests...
deploy-bot: Smoke results: auth=ok, embeddings=ok, streaming=failed (stream init timeout ~6s). See logs: /var/logs/ci/streaming-345.log
Dinesh: Saw the streaming flake. Re-running with increased client timeout and retry enabled.
Dinesh: Update: streaming passes with timeout bump and retry flag in harness. Marking smoke as pass.
Micah: Good. Add mitigation note to rollback playbook: increase client timeout before rollback.
Kevin: Recommend pinning runtime kernel to avoid perf regression — use kernel 2024-11-rc-k1 for this rollout.
Micah: Pinned in artifact manifest. Snippet: ```json
{"version":"v2.7.0-rc3","runtime_kernel":"2024-11-rc-k1","flags":{"new_routing":false}}
```
Anika: Security signoff requested. @Emma can you confirm?
Emma: SecOps: quick review done. No new secrets, KMS policies validated. 👍
Micah: Final signoff request for promotion at 15:45 PT — drop ack here if you own rollback/monitoring during the window.
Kevin: Ack — I'll own canary metrics and rollback decisioning.
Dinesh: Ack — smoke/e2e owner during canary.
Emma: Ack — security/keys.
Micah: Note: deploy-bot auto-suspend will trigger and tag the run as 'promo-failed-1930001111' if canary thresholds breached.
deploy-bot: Scheduling promotion for 16:00 PT. Promotion requested by @Micah. Canary policy applied.
Micah: Paste of brief release notes for internal record: ```
- Fix: reduce tokenization overhead in streaming path
- Perf: kernel tuning for lower memory jitter (p95 improvements)
- Ops: autoscale policy adjusted for bursty inference loads
- Note: no DB migrations; feature routing flag OFF by default
```
Kevin: Small ask: hold promotion if downstream redis latency spikes by >10ms during canary.
Micah: Agreed — we'll abort if redis latency spike detected.
deploy-bot: Promotion started -> promoting v2.7.0-rc3 to canary (5%).
deploy-bot: Canary metrics (10m window): 2000 reqs, errors 0.12%, p95 latency +12ms. Status: healthy.
Dinesh: Running e2e against canary instances now — everything looks green from client tests.
deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 25% as scheduled.
deploy-bot: Canary stable at 25% for 45m. metrics: errors 0.15%, p95 +18ms. No downstream redis spikes.
Kevin: All clear from monitoring side. Proceed to full promote.
deploy-bot: Gradual promotion to 100% in progress... 60% -> 100%
deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Tagging release: prod-v2.7.0. Release notes URL: https://internal/release/2.7.0
Micah: Congrats team. Closing thread — please file any post-deploy notes if you observed anomalies.
